## S6 Fig — Cell volume and mitochondrial/cell volume ratio

Per-cell measurements were obtained from fluorescence microscopy images using
the following image analysis pipeline:

1. **Image preprocessing** — Fiji macro scripts in `Macro Script for imageJ/`.
2. **Cell segmentation** — Cell boundaries segmented using
   [Cellpose](https://cellpose.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
3. **Mitochondrial volume** — Mitochondrial network volume per cell quantified
   using [MitoGraph](https://github.com/vianamp/MitoGraph).

The figure was assembled in Fiji. Source data are in
`figure6/source_data/Figure 6-source data.xlsx` (sheets: Figure S6A, Figure S6B).

**Panel A:** Per-cell cell volume (µm³) for WT vs rim15\u0394 across three conditions
(Proliferation, Carbon starvation, Phosphorus starvation).

**Panel B:** Per-cell mitochondrial/cell volume ratio (%) for WT vs rim15\u0394
across three conditions.

```{r s6-source-data}
# Helper: parse wide-format sheet (row1=title, row2=condition, row3=genotype, rows4+=values)
parse_wide_sheet <- function(sheet, value_col) {
  raw <- read_excel(src_file, sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE)
  conditions <- as.character(raw[2, ])
  for (i in seq_along(conditions))
    if (is.na(conditions[i]) && i > 1) conditions[i] <- conditions[i - 1]
  genotypes <- as.character(raw[3, ])
  map2_dfr(seq_len(ncol(raw)), conditions, function(col_i, cond) {
    vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw[[col_i]][4:nrow(raw)]))
    tibble(condition = cond, genotype = genotypes[col_i],
           !!value_col := vals[!is.na(vals)])
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      condition = recode(condition,
        "phosphorus starvation" = "Phosphorus starvation",
        "Phosphorus starvation" = "Phosphorus starvation"),
      condition = factor(condition,
        levels = c("Proliferation", "Carbon starvation", "Phosphorus starvation")),
      genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("WT", "rim15\u0394"))
    )
}

cell_vol  <- parse_wide_sheet("Figure S6A", "cell_volume_um3")
mito_frac <- parse_wide_sheet("Figure S6B", "mito_cell_pct")

stopifnot(nrow(cell_vol) > 0, nrow(mito_frac) > 0)
message("S6A cell volume: ",    nrow(cell_vol),  " per-cell measurements")
message("S6B mito/cell ratio: ", nrow(mito_frac), " per-cell measurements")
cell_vol  %>% count(condition, genotype)
mito_frac %>% count(condition, genotype)
```
